test_command: cmake --build build --config Debug --target test_exe > $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Set-Location build/bin/Debug; ./test_exe.exe --gtest_filter=PlayerRestTest.*

mutations.catches: a hostile standing exactly at the edge of the danger zone counted as outside it
the danger zone growing by a tile, so resting is refused where it should be allowed
a corpse lying nearby counted as a living threat
the attitude test inverted, so a shopkeeper blocks the rest and an orc does not
a player at exactly full health resting anyway, spending the turn for nothing
the danger zone measured as a diamond rather than a square, so a diagonal hostile reads as further away than it is
